7/31 @ 7pm Byzantio's: Occult Society of Houston Meet and Greet

Hey guys! Had a great turn out last week so thanks to those who came!

The Houston Occult Society is a small, but growing, group of magic users in the greater Houston area. Houston has a large variety of magic practitioners and it's important that we get to know each other.

Not into this sort of stuff but curious? Then come on down. We're pretty relaxed and open to whoever wants to ask questions.

We meet at Byzantio's which is a Mediterranean restaurant that also has Hookah. It is located off of Grey St. and is only a couple blocks down from Allen Parkway and Whole Foods Montrose. There is plenty of room for parking and if you're from outside inner loop then Allen Parkway will get you there with little hassle.

Feel free to ask questions either here or on the facebook page for the group.

In celebration of the Blue Moon tonight we will be conducting a Lunar working to charge personal talismans or objects after coffee night. All are welcome to attend.

If you can not make coffee night but still would like to come feel free to message me and I will give you the location.

Parchment and writing instruments will be provided so you may craft a talisman when you arrive.

We look forward to seeing/meeting everyone!

IANAL, but I've heard that passwords and lock codes are intellectual evidence. So, if anyone takes your device and demands you to unlock/unencrypt it, one of two things can happen:

  1. Intellectual evidence can't be levied from you in the US due to self-incrimination. You can't be forced to incriminate yourself, and giving away the password or unlocking/unencrypting your device is tantamount to that.

  2. Physical evidence can be taken without your consent... including your fingerprints. They can force you to unlock your phone with your fingerprint, and that's not against the law.

So, I'm not going to make things easy for them. If they want my data for some reason, I'm going to make them work for it. They're going to have to spend countless hours decrypting my device, sector by sector... I refuse to make it easier for them.
